text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad Mimi's okay!
But who is that strange girl with her?
choice_data_list: They look like such good friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミが無事でよかったです。
けど、
あの女の子は誰なんでしょう……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
What, really? [i]That's[/i] how you react in this situation?!
You really are the most suspicious creep!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなときに、
どうしてそんなところを見てるんですか！
あなたはやっぱり
へんたいふしんしゃさんです！！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
If Mimi's having fun, I guess she can't be a bad girl...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね。
ミミが楽しそうだから、
悪い子じゃないんでしょうけど……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh! Wahhhh!
I'm not listening!
I didn't hear a single word!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わー！　
何も聞こえません！
何も聞こえませんからね！
